params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.

params.name: search_semantics
params.description: How to interpret the search input.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to posts modified after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to posts modified before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: status
params.description: Limit result set to items assigned one or more statuses. Anonymously only `publish` is permitted; any other value returns 400 rest_invalid_param or 401.

params.name: author
params.description: Limit result set to attachments assigned to specific authors.

params.name: author_exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes attachments assigned to specific authors.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit result set to items with particular parent identifiers.

params.name: parent_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to all items except those of a particular parent identifier.

params.name: media_type
params.description: Limit result set to attachments of a particular media type.

params.name: mime_type
params.description: Limit result set to attachments of a particular MIME type.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by attachment attribute.

items.docs: Lists the media library — 661 attachments at harvest time, including the corporate imagery, press-release assets and scientific figures used across the site.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the object.

params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.
